content.short: MoonPay provides a fast and simple way to buy and sell cryptocurrencies.
content.description: MoonPay, launched in 2019, provides a fast and straightforward way to buy and sell cryptocurrencies. The service enables users to purchase and sell crypto using traditional payment methods, including Visa and Mastercard, making access to digital assets easy and familiar. Beyond individual use, MoonPay offers a business payment on-ramp to facilitate fiat-to-crypto transactions for companies and operates an NFT payment processor to support payments in NFT markets. The platform emphasizes simplicity and broad payment support to streamline onboarding for both individuals and businesses.
